text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 — auth failures for tenant `pinecrest-health` (VPC). Symptom: 500 / 401 spikes from private endpoint, started ~10:03 UTC. Auto-escalation to oncall.

oncall-anna: I’m on it. Triage window starting. Anyone see alerts in Console? 

sre-jamal: I see a sharp increase in `auth.reject` errors from the VPC ingress: "jwt kid mismatch" and "jwks fetch 404". Request traces show validation failing during token introspection. 

eng-ali: Checking keystore sync job. The tenant keystore job just ran at 09:58 UTC — it pushed a new signing key with kid `k-2026-03-15`.

security-maya: Could be a key rotation race. If downstream services are still using old kid and the JWKS propagation failed, validation will drop tokens. Any JWKS fetch errors from our side? 

sre-jamal: Yes, JWKS GET to the customer’s OIDC endpoint returning 404 for the new kid for a subset of edge nodes. Logs show intermittent 502 from the egress NAT in the VPC during the time window.

oncall-anna: Paging customer SRE? @solutions-rachel can you reach out to Pinecrest contact and confirm if they pushed a partial key set? 

solutions-rachel: Reached out via their support channel. They confirm they rotated keys at 09:58 but an internal firewall rule blocked some of our egress IPs temporarily — their infra team is investigating. They can re-push if needed.

pm-lina: Customer impact: authentication failures cause API requests to fail for ~12% of requests, mostly in eu-west region. Need mitigation ASAP, and then a durable fix.

eng-ali: Quick mitigation idea: enable JWKS cache fallback on the VPC auth proxy so nodes that fail to fetch the new JWKS will continue accepting tokens signed by cached keys for a short window. This is a config flip we can roll in a minute.

sre-jamal: Agreed. I can toggle `allow_jwks_cache_fallback=true` for the `pinecrest-health` tenant on the private control plane. That will accept tokens matching cached keys for 5m while we reconcile.

oncall-anna: Do it. Also enable verbose logs for jwks fetch to confirm success/failure after the flip. Inform customer we’re applying a temporary safety window.

sre-jamal: Flipping now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: starting config update for tenant `pinecrest-health` (allow_jwks_cache_fallback=true)

sre-jamal: Done — flip applied to all nodes in the dedicated pool. Monitoring now.

sre-jamal: Error rate dropped from 12% -> 1.5% in 60s. Latency stable. Looks like fallback worked. :thumbsup:

eng-ali: I’m rolling a small rollback plugin to prefer local keystore if JWKS fetch fails with 4xx/5xx for <10s. Will cut a canary to 2 nodes first.

security-maya: We should avoid permissive acceptance for long. Add a hard TTL: cache fallback max 10m and an auto-disable if JWKS becomes available with the new kid.

sre-jamal: Implemented TTL enforcement. `jwks_cache_ttl_override=600s`. Also added a telemetry counter for "jwks_fallback_used" so we can alert if it persists.

solutions-rachel: Pinecrest just confirmed they opened a temporary allowlist for our egress IPs and re-pushed the JWKS. They see the new key present for all regions.

eng-ali: Confirming from our side: JWKS GET succeeded for all nodes, new kid `k-2026-03-15` visible everywhere. Starting to drain fallback.

sre-jamal: Draining fallback now — set `allow_jwks_cache_fallback=false` and leaving the TTL to expire naturally. Error rate down to baseline.

oncall-anna: Customer-facing note: "We mitigated an auth regression caused by a key rotation propagation gap. We applied a temporary JWKS cache fallback while your team validated egress rules. Requests are now healthy. We'll follow up with a root cause and actions." @solutions-rachel please send.

solutions-rachel: Sent — customer acknowledged and thanked the team. They will add our egress block to their runbook to avoid recurrence.

pm-lina: Next actions (short):
- Postmortem owner: @pm-lina
- Action 1: Add automated validation to rotation job to verify global JWKS visibility before sweeping the roll. Owner: eng-ali
- Action 2: Add egress IP check & retry backoff to keystore propagation. Owner: sre-jamal
- Action 3: Update customer onboarding doc for VPC egress allowlist. Owner: solutions-rachel

security-maya: Also add an option to schedule staggered rotations across regions or a versioned rotation that ensures backwards-compatible signing for at least 10m.

eng-ali: Will draft the automated validation and a canary rotation mode.

oncall-anna: Incident classified P1 -> mitigated. Starting RCA doc. I’ll update the incident channel with a link once the postmortem page is created.

incident-bot: incident-closed: mitigation applied. Postmortem required.

sre-jamal: Leaving a note: we observed egress NAT flapping correlated with the time of rotation. We should correlate with infra autoscale events.

pm-lina: Thanks team. Great coordination. If anyone wants to add logs or snippets to RCA, paste them into the postmortem doc.

eng-ali: Snippet I used to validate JWKS from our worker nodes:
```
curl -sS https://pinecrest-oidc.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[] | {kid: .kid, alg: .alg}'
```

sre-jamal: And the control plane command I ran to flip fallback (internal):
```
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant pinecrest-health --set allow_jwks_cache_fallback=true
```

oncall-anna: Closing thread here, moving to postmortem doc. Thanks everyone :heart:
